description.p: FauxPi is a Raspberry Pi hardware simulator supporting the Raspberry Pi 1 (A+, B+), Raspberry Pi 3 (A+, B+), and Raspberry Pi Zero (Zero, Zero W, Zero 2 W) families.

ul.li: VideoCore IV HVS/V3D graphics and HDMI display output
Interactive board sheet to connect/disconnect peripherals, inspect GPIO pins, and adjust CPU temperature
Copy-on-write QCOW2 SD card image management
USB HID keyboard/mouse, user-mode NAT Ethernet & Wi-Fi, and HDMI/PWM audio
